text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the open campus has finally 
arrived! Acting as an escort, I guided the 
children around alongside Vodka and the 
others.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Woah! It's completely different from my 
school! I guess studying here must be 
really hard too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time for a quiz! Do you know what 
they call horse girls who run in the 
"Oaks" and "Shuka Sho"?

text_block_list.name: Energetic Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I've heard that before~! Um, um... 
Tiara horse girls!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Wonderful, that is correct. You must 
be studying very hard all the time.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Then do you guys know this one? Which 
horse girls have won the Triple Tiara so 
far?
choice_data_list:
(Yeah! Looks like all the preparation paid 
off.)

(Yeah! Looks like all the preparation paid 
off.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next was time to experience the training 
course. Changing into tracksuits, everyone 
headed outside together.

text_block_list.name: Rambunctious Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, it's so huge~! I've always wanted 
to try running 3200m! Hey, run alongside 
me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, sounds good! I'll carry you on my 
back if you get tuckered out, so give it 
everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Mischievous Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~! Vodka-san is running with me! We're 
gonna dash across the dirt course full 
throttle! Come on, let's do it~!!

text_block_list.name: Tomboyish Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
I wanna train on the uphill course! It'll 
make me super strong, right? Let's make a 
killer special move together!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa!? H-Hold up! Don't all come at me 
at once...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! In that case, it's our time to 
shine!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
All right, raise your hand if you want to 
try the uphill slope! I'll teach you some 
official Tracen Academy special training.

text_block_list.name: Mischievous Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's my first time seeing a track 
this huge~! I'm gonna leave tons of 
footprints everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, full of energy, aren't you! Then how 
about something like this?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Run all the way around in a circle and 
connect your footprints! Can you draw a 
nice, pretty circle?

text_block_list.name: Mischievous Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! That sounds so fun! I hope I can 
make a perfect circle~!

text_block_list.name: Tomboyish Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yay, training time~! You pull a big tire 
with a rope, right?! Maybe I'll learn a 
special move!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, let's give it a try first. If 
it gets too tough, tell me right away, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Tomboyish Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh...! H-Huh? It's not moving at 
all...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It's pretty tough training, after all... 
How about we switch to a lighter tire and 
try dashing up the slope with all your 
might? I'm sure you'll gain some 
mysterious new power!

text_block_list.name: Tomboyish Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! I'll try that! All right, I'm 
gonna do my best!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Cesario, Sweep, you guys are 
amazing! All the kids' eyes are totally 
sparkling!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, Vodka-san. It's all thanks to 
you, you know.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Being close to them, and truly accepting 
how they feel—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I just took a page from your book when 
figuring out how to connect with the 
children.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You learned from me...? Heheh, is that so? 
Well then—!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll hype things up even more! Hey, 
you guys! Let's have a race over there! 
I'll take all of you on!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Huh, against Vodka-san?! Yaaay! It's a 
match!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka and the little kids line up side by 
side. Raising a hand high in the air—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —UOOOOOHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! Ugh~, I lost...

text_block_list.name: Energetic Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
But that was so cool! Vodka-san, you gave 
it your all with such a serious look! It 
got my heart pounding so fast!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Even against little children, you 
took their feelings head-on. That was 
truly a run worthy of you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
To those kids... you're like a reliable 
big sister and a great friend.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the open campus ended 
with great success. I spotted Vodka 
grinning happily to herself.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You bet~! I got thank-you letters from the 
kids, and get this—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I want to become a cool horse girl just 
like Vodka-san!" they wrote!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh...♪ In that case, I gotta make sure 
I stay someone they can look up to!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, while walking through 
town after school, I saw a familiar trio 
of horse girls.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Come on, huuuu-rrryyyy up~! The dessert 
buffet is gonna close!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, we still have plenty of time, okay? 
Though I totally understand why you're so 
excited♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Guess I got no choice, I'll tag along with 
you guys all the way today. After all, 
it's our celebration party!
